tools.name: get_wai_overview
tools.description: Wai is the clinic platform for private clinics, hospitals, health systems and governments worldwide. Returns what it does, the plans with monthly prices in USD, the terms of the pilot for a clinic group, where it is live, and how to start. Clinician is bought online by the clinician, and every other

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Send a demo request to the Wai team for a clinic, on the person's behalf and with their agreement. The team replies by email within 1 working day. Needs the person's name, work email and clinic name; city and a message are optional.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Every Wai plan with its published price in USD, who it is for, its page and how to start it, plus the group pilot and the seller's terms. Use get_plan for one plan in full.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: One plan in full: what it does, who it is for, what is included as the pricing page lists it, the price, the billing and data terms, and the proof to weigh it (the security pages' compliance status for HIPAA, UK GDPR, the NHS DSPT, data residency and SOC 2, the integrations that exist, and published

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Returns the link to Wai's own sign-up with the 7-day trial chosen, for one clinician. The person opens it, creates the account with their own registration number and confirms there. Nothing is charged by following the link, and this tool sends nothing.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Returns the link to Wai's own sign-up with Clinician or Clinician Plus chosen, or to set up Wai Checkout. The page states the price and terms, and the person confirms and pays there. The agent never enters a card. Studio is scoped in a demo, so it answers with how to request one.
